decisions.reason: Having survived the earlier review while a comparable condenser was withdrawn, this version likely meets aspiration better and remains worth retaining in a growing market.
The tube-liner offering strengthens service revenues and uses existing repair capabilities, so with low resource strain management would keep it unless performance clearly slips below aspiration.
The customized air-cooler line fits the firm's core engineering and solution model and, in an expanding firm, is likely above or near aspiration after two years of learning.
Repair inserts are a small but capability-consistent aftermarket product, and the firm would usually keep such a niche unless observed demand persistently underperforms aspiration.
